subject: CareWise trial: acceptance criteria, PoC plan & exec decision rhythm
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@carewise.health>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@carewise.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: CareWise discovery recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can align on a short trial and a clean exec decision window. High level notes:

- Primary use case: real-time clinical summarization + coding suggestions for discharge notes (50–60k notes/mo).
- Key constraints: P95 latency target for single-note inference, strict PHI handling, preservation of recall for diagnosis codes.
- Internal owners you mentioned: Priya (Product), Alex (Clinical Ops).

Action items I outlined on the call (proposed owners & timeline):
1) Share PoC plan and mutual action plan (MA P) — Redwood (Soojin) — I can send by EOD Monday.
2) Agree success criteria (metrics below) — CareWise (Priya/Alex) — confirm by Tue.
3) Security questionnaire + baseline evidence (SOC2, data flow diagram) — Redwood (Marcus) — 5 business days.
4) Trial run: 3 weeks of live inference on a representative subset, with eval harness run daily — joint.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or edit):
- Latency: P95 inference latency < 150 ms for 50% of production-style payloads (target).
- Quality: Top-5 code recall >= 92% vs your annotated set; summarization ROUGE-L relative baseline improvement >= 12%.
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during trial windows (business hours).
- Cost: projected token cost <= $X per 1M tokens (placeholder until we size throughput).

I'll attach a short PoC plan + mutual action plan that maps owners and timelines. If those success criteria look off, call them out — we'll adjust.

Next step: Priya/Alex, could you confirm the acceptance criteria and whether the 3-week trial length is workable? If yes, we'll propose concrete dates and a final readout window for your execs (we typically schedule an exec review 7–10 business days after trial close to allow evaluation).

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0198

Attachments: (stubs) carewise-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-poc-profile.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@carewise.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@carewise.health>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CareWise discovery recap & next steps

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear recap. Priya and I reviewed and made a few edits to the success criteria. Inline replies below.

> Proposed success criteria — please confirm or edit:

- Latency: P95 inference latency < 150 ms for 50% of production-style payloads (target).
  - Alex: Can we clarify the payload distribution? Our average note size is ~1,200 tokens but there are long notes up to 5k. We care about P95 on our 90th percentile payload.

- Quality: Top-5 code recall >= 92% vs your annotated set; summarization ROUGE-L relative baseline improvement >= 12%.
  - Priya: Top-5 recall target seems reasonable; can we also include a precision floor (>= 78%) so suggestions aren't noisy?

- Reliability: 99.5% availability during trial windows (business hours).
  - Alex: we also need a short SLA on error rates (<= 0.2% failed requests).

- Cost: projected token cost <= $X per 1M tokens (placeholder).
  - Priya: send us an estimate once you have baseline throughput numbers.

Two additional asks:
1) Data retention — we need confirmation that ephemeral KV cache and prompt artifacts used for the trial will be purged after 30 days unless otherwise agreed.
2) Security evidence — can you share a minimal packet (SOC2 summary + data flow diagram) we can run by our InfoSec?

If you can update the attachment and call out the payload size assumptions for latency, we can sign off on the criteria by Tuesday EOD. Also confirm the proposed trial length (3 weeks) — lean towards 3 weeks but may prefer 4 if you need warm-up time.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Clinical Ops | CareWise Health
alex.moreno@carewise.health | +1 415-555-0122
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@carewise.health>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@carewise.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 June 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: CareWise PoC plan (updated) + intake questions

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the quick feedback — attaching an updated mutual action plan that: (a) calls out payload-size buckets and which bucket we'll use for latency SLOs, (b) adds a precision floor (>= 78%) to the quality criteria, and (c) records the short SLA on failed requests.

Summary of what's changed from the draft:
- Latency measurement: we will instrument the trial with your 90th-percentile payload bucket (notes between 1k–3k tokens) for the P95 target. We'll also report P95s for the <1k and >3k buckets for visibility.
- Quality: Top-5 recall >= 92% and precision >= 78% measured against a 500-note annotated validation set you provide.
- Trial length: Recommend 3 weeks active after a 3–5 day warm-up/validation window (total ~4 weeks calendar).
- Data handling: Redwood will configure ephemeral KV caches and will delete trial prompt artifacts and caches 30 days after trial completion by default. We can amend retention in writing if needed.
- Security: Marcus has pulled together a short packet (SOC2 summary + data flow diagram) — see attached stub. Full questionnaire responses will follow in 5 business days.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (prep): onboarding, data slices, validation set (owner: Priya) — 3–5 days
- Week 1–3 (trial): active inference and daily eval harness runs (owner: Redwood + CareWise ops)
- Week 4 (analysis): joint evaluation window and final metrics compilation (owner: joint)
- Exec readout: 7–10 business days after the trial analysis window closes — propose a few slots.

Proposed exec-readout windows (pick one):
- Tue, 2027-07-06 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, 2027-07-08 14:00–15:00 PT
- Tue, 2027-07-13 09:00–10:00 PT

If you confirm the criteria and one of those windows, we'll hold the slot and share a readout deck template and decision rubric (go/no-go) so the execs have a lightweight packet to review.

Attachments: (stubs) carewise-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (updated), redwood-security-reqs-stub.pdf

Thanks —
Soojin
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@carewise.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@carewise.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 June 2027 10:58:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CareWise PoC plan (updated) + intake questions

Soojin / Alex —

This looks good and thanks for being explicit on payload buckets and retention. We confirm:
- Acceptance criteria as updated (recall, precision, latency on the 1k–3k bucket).
- 3-week active trial with a short warm-up window — OK. We'll target the shorter warm-up (3 days).
- Security stub received; InfoSec will expect the full questionnaire in 5 business days.

Exec readout: Thu, 2027-07-08 14:00–15:00 PT works for our execs (I confirmed with our PM and Director). Please hold that slot.

One house-keeping note: can Redwood provide an evaluation summary template that maps exactly to the decision rubric you mentioned? It helps our Director prepare a 5–8 slide internal brief before the readout.

Priya
Priya Desai
VP Product | CareWise Health

Best,
